method: For each tool, one OpenAlex works search (the search= parameter, which covers title, abstract and full text where OpenAlex has it, using OpenAlex boolean syntax) grouped by publication_year: mentions_all is meta.count and mentions_since_2020 is the sum of the 2020-2026 year groups. Ambiguous names are paired with required context words. precision_estimate is set only for the six largest counts, from a random sample of 10 records each (sample=10, seed=7) judged by title and abstract; other tools' informal checks are in their notes. canonical_paper.cited_by is OpenAlex cited_by_count looked up by DOI, a different measure from mention counts.

tools.name: Ansys HFSS
tools.query: (HFSS AND (antenna OR microwave OR electromagnetic OR Ansys OR Ansoft OR waveguide)) OR "High Frequency Structure Simulator"
tools.note: Bare 'HFSS' also matches 'HFSs' (hesitant fuzzy sets), so the query requires an RF/EM context word. Sample still had 2.5/10 off-target (fuzzy-set paper, magazine issue). Includes HFSS-IE/SBR+ mentions.

tools.name: Ansys HFSS-IE / HFSS SBR+
tools.note: Subset of HFSS mentions; papers often write just 'HFSS', so this undercounts.

tools.name: COMSOL Multiphysics RF Module
tools.note: 'electromagnetic waves' also matches the Wave Optics module interface and incidental wording; some thermal-only COMSOL papers leak in.

tools.name: CST Studio Suite (CST Microwave Studio)
tools.query: "CST Microwave Studio" OR "CST Studio Suite" OR "CST MWS"
tools.note: Phrase query; misses papers that write only 'CST' or 'CST Studio', so it likely undercounts.

tools.name: Cadence AWR AXIEM / AWR Analyst
tools.note: Many papers name only 'Microwave Office' even when AXIEM was the EM engine, so this undercounts.

tools.name: Cadence AWR Microwave Office
tools.note: Mostly a circuit simulator; this count is not an EM-solver measure. Do not rank against EM solvers.

tools.name: Cadence Clarity 3D Solver
tools.note: Released 2019; the 'Clarity 3D' phrase may catch unrelated uses.

tools.name: Cadence EMX
tools.query: EMX AND (Cadence OR Integrand) AND (inductor OR electromagnetic OR transformer)
tools.note: 'EMX' collides with Emx genes and other acronyms; query requires Cadence/Integrand plus an EM word, so it undercounts.

tools.name: Keysight EMPro
tools.query: EMPro AND (Keysight OR Agilent OR FDTD OR electromagnetic)

tools.name: Keysight ADS Momentum
tools.query: "ADS Momentum" OR "Keysight Momentum" OR "Agilent Momentum" OR "Momentum simulator"
tools.note: 'Momentum' is a common word, so only product phrases are counted; papers writing 'Momentum in ADS' are missed. Informal sample 8.5/10 on target (one physics false positive).

tools.name: Keysight RFPro
tools.note: Released 2018; front end to Momentum and FEM engines.

tools.name: Palace
tools.query: Palace AND "finite element" AND electromagnetic AND (AWS OR Amazon OR awslabs)
tools.note: Common word; strict query (Palace + finite element + electromagnetic + AWS/Amazon) undercounts. No canonical paper found in OpenAlex.

tools.name: Elmer FEM
tools.owner: CSC - IT Center for Science (open source)
tools.query: ("Elmer FEM" OR ElmerFEM OR "Elmer multiphysics" OR "Elmer finite element") AND (electromagnetic OR Maxwell)
tools.note: 'Elmer' is a common name (and Elmer/Ice is glaciology); strict EM query undercounts. No journal canonical paper.

tools.name: NGSolve
tools.note: Restricted to EM context. No NGSolve software paper indexed; users often cite the Netgen mesher paper (doi:10.1007/s007910050004, 1209 cites), not counted here.

tools.name: GetDP

canonical_paper.title: A general environment for the treatment of discrete problems and its application to the finite element method

tools.note: Mostly low-frequency/magnetics EM. Informal sample 6.5/10 on target (off-topic economics and astrophysics hits, likely text-extraction noise). The Gmsh paper (7816 cites) is the mesher and is not counted.

tools.name: MFEM
tools.query: MFEM AND (LLNL OR "Lawrence Livermore" OR "mfem.org") AND (Maxwell OR electromagnetic)

canonical_paper.title: MFEM: A modular finite element methods library

tools.note: 'MFEM' also means 'mixed finite element method'; query requires LLNL plus Maxwell/EM, so it undercounts. Paper citations cover all MFEM uses, not only EM.

tools.name: ZMT Sim4Life / SEMCAD X
tools.note: Sample included focused-ultrasound (acoustic) uses, which are not EM. Also has quasi-static EM solvers.

tools.name: IMST EMPIRE XPU
tools.query: "EMPIRE XPU" OR "EMPIRE XCcel" OR (EMPIRE AND IMST)

tools.name: Ansys Lumerical FDTD
tools.note: Query is Lumerical AND FDTD, so it may include Lumerical MODE/varFDTD users who also mention FDTD.

tools.name: Flexcompute Tidy3D
tools.note: Launched about 2020; query also matches the company name.

tools.name: Altair Feko
tools.query: FEKO AND (antenna OR electromagnetic OR "method of moments")
tools.note: Query requires an antenna/EM context word. Sample had one proceedings table-of-contents record.

tools.name: openEMS
tools.query: openEMS AND (FDTD OR electromagnetic OR antenna)

canonical_paper.title: openEMS - a free and open source equivalent-circuit (EC) FDTD simulation platform supporting cylindrical coordinates suitable for the analysis of traveling wave MRI applications

tools.note: 'OpenEMS' is also an energy-management name (378 bare hits); query requires FDTD/EM/antenna. Most users cite the website, so the paper citation count is low.

tools.name: MEEP

canonical_paper.title: Meep: A flexible free-software package for electromagnetic simulations by the FDTD method

tools.note: Query requires FDTD wording, so it undercounts. Informal sample 10/10 in EM context.

tools.name: gprMax

canonical_paper.title: gprMax: Open source software to simulate electromagnetic wave propagation for Ground Penetrating Radar

tools.note: Unique name. Informal sample 10/10 GPR context.

tools.name: TICRA ESTEAM
tools.note: Only 1 hit; papers rarely name ESTEAM. Count is not meaningful.

tools.name: Nullspace EM
tools.note: Retrieved 2026-10-17. "Nullspace" alone is the linear-algebra term, so only exact product and company phrases were tried: "Nullspace EM" 0, "Nullspace ES" 0, Nullspace AND IERUS 0, "Nullspace Inc" 2 (both IEEE Microwave Magazine IMS Preview issues, exhibitor listings). Not a usable measure; the page shows no count.

tools.name: TICRA GRASP
tools.note: 'GRASP' is a common acronym; query requires TICRA, so it undercounts.

tools.name: NEC-2 / NEC (and 4nec2)
tools.query: "Numerical Electromagnetics Code" OR 4nec2 OR (("NEC-2" OR NEC2) AND antenna)
tools.note: Includes NEC-4 and generic 'Numerical Electromagnetics Code' mentions. The Burke & Poggio 1981 report has no DOI. Informal sample 10/10 antenna context.

tools.name: NEC-4
tools.note: Retrieved 2026-10-17. Overlaps the NEC-2 row, whose "Numerical Electromagnetics Code" phrase also matches NEC-4 papers. Informal sample 8/10 antenna or NEC context (off: a standardisation thesis and a metrology comparison).

tools.name: EZNEC
tools.note: Retrieved 2026-10-17. Bare EZNEC gives 74 hits with some text-extraction noise (a processor-simulator thesis, a forestry article); the antenna context word removes them. Informal sample 9/10 on target (one book index).

tools.name: MMANA-GAL
tools.note: Retrieved 2026-10-17. Bare MMANA gives 2,126 hits, mostly noise in medical, maths and Indonesian or Ukrainian texts, so the query needs the full name or an antenna word. Informal sample 7/10 on target; many hits are Indonesian and Ukrainian student antenna papers.

tools.name: Bempp-cl

canonical_paper.title: Bempp-cl: A fast Python based just-in-time compiling boundary element library.

tools.note: Includes older Bempp versions and non-EM (acoustic, Laplace) BEM uses.

tools.name: Sonnet (incl. Sonnet Lite)
tools.query: Sonnet AND (microstrip OR "planar electromagnetic" OR "EM simulator" OR "electromagnetic simulator")
tools.note: 'Sonnet' is a poetry word; query requires microstrip/planar-EM wording, so it undercounts. Informal sample 10/10 RF context.

tools.name: Remcom Wireless InSite
tools.note: Many hits use the DeepMIMO dataset (generated with Wireless InSite) rather than run the tool. Informal sample 9/10 in context.

tools.name: WinProp
tools.query: WinProp AND (propagation OR "ray tracing" OR Altair OR AWE)
tools.note: Retrieved 2026-10-17. Bare WinProp gives 996 hits; the context words give 463. Informal sample 8/10 on target (off: an RFID protocol paper and a leaky-wave antenna paper). Includes channel-simulator comparisons that only name WinProp.

tools.name: Sionna RT

canonical_paper.title: Sionna RT: Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling

tools.note: Released 2023. Some hits only mention or cite Sionna; includes software-release records. Informal sample 9/10 in context.

tools.name: Ansys Perceive EM
tools.note: Retrieved 2026-10-17. The phrase "Perceive EM" alone gives 176 hits, 63 of them before the product existed (ordinary wording), so Ansys is required. All 4 remaining hits (2025-2026) are radar digital-twin papers. Too new for a meaningful count.

tools.name: Ansys Q3D Extractor / 2D Extractor
tools.query: "Q3D Extractor" OR (Q3D AND (Ansys OR Ansoft)) OR "2D Extractor"
tools.note: 'Q3D' also appears in non-EM contexts (3D imaging, structural ANSYS papers). Informal sample 6.5/10 on target.

tools.name: Polar Instruments Si9000
tools.note: Mostly an industry tool; few publications name it.

tools.name: FastHenry

canonical_paper.title: FASTHENRY: a multipole-accelerated 3-D inductance extraction program

tools.note: 3D magneto-quasi-static solver (q2d key used for quasi-static).

tools.name: FastCap

canonical_paper.title: FastCap: a multipole accelerated 3-D capacitance extraction program

tools.note: 3D electrostatic solver (q2d key used for quasi-static).

tools.name: ASITIC

canonical_paper.title: Analysis, design, and optimization of spiral inductors and transformers for Si RF ICs

tools.note: Bare 'ASITIC' (2659 hits) is inflated by line-break hyphenation of 'par-asitic' (sample: 0/10 relevant); 'ASITIC AND inductor' still only 2.5/10. Count uses ASITIC AND Niknejad AND inductor: precise (informal sample about 9.5/10) but an undercount.

tools.name: MMTL
tools.note: 'MMTL' is ambiguous; query requires 'transmission line'. Small count.
